source_line: Source: Nvidia investor calendar; S&P 500 weightings, Nov. 2026
caption:
Wall Street is holding a watch party tonight — and your 401(k) is on the guest list.

Nvidia reports earnings after today's close. It's the most valuable company in the world and the biggest single stock in the S&P 500 — about 8% of the whole index. Own an index fund or a target-date 401(k)? It's quietly your largest bet.

Investors will read the report as a verdict on the AI boom. The stock has slipped from its $5 trillion peak going in.

My take: you don't have to watch the ticker, but one company now moves the fund millions of people retire on.

How much of your portfolio is Nvidia? 👇
